verses.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!

segments.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!

verses.text: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

segments.text: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

verses.text: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.

segments.text: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.

verses.text: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah

segments.text: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah

verses.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

segments.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

verses.text: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.

segments.text: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.

verses.text: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.

segments.text: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.

verses.text: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah

segments.text: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah

verses.text: Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.

segments.text: Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.

verses.text: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

segments.text: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

verses.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.

segments.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.

verses.text: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!

segments.text: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
